messages:
Sam: Quick micro-poll  kitchen mystery jar restock. Which treat should replace the empty jar? React or reply.
Options:
• :cookie: Chocolate chip cookies
• :candy: Gummy bears
• :pretzel: Salted pretzels
• :chocolate_bar: Dark chocolate squares

Olivia: :cookie: Cookies please. morale boost.

Chen: :pretzel: Pretzels  less sugar, more crunch.

Riley: :candy: Gummy bears for nostalgia.

Morgan: :chocolate_bar: Dark chocolate. fancy but tiny portions.

Sam: also open to write-ins. someone suggested "trail mix" earlier.

Olivia: write-in: Trail mix is a power move.

poll-bot: Poll closed after 45m. Results: Cookies 2, Pretzels 1, Gummy bears 1, Dark chocolate 1, Write-ins: Trail mix 1. Cookies win! :tada:

Chen: Nice. I'll drop a note to office ops to restock cookies and a backup jar of trail mix.

Riley: side poll: quick editor preference for weekend pairing  one word only: vim / emacs / vscode / nano

Morgan: vscode

Olivia: vim

Sam: emacs

Chen: vscode

poll-bot: Editor mini-poll closed (10m). Results: vim 1, emacs 1, vscode 2, nano 0. vscode wins for the pair session.

Sam: cool! I'll schedule a 30-min co-editing slot Sunday evening. Thanks all :)
